text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
I hope you didn't wait long. 
—Little snow angel.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
N-N-N-Not at all, ma'am! 
Thank you so, so much for inviting us 
all the way to Morioka...! T-Thank you 
kindly~!
choice_data_list:
Thank you so much for your kind 
invitation...!

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
Even lovelier than the rumors say. 
Much like a little rabbit sculpted of 
fresh, fluffy snow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It all began a few weeks ago, 
with a single letter of invitation.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Why would THE Saint Lite-san 
in-in-in-invite us of all people~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hailing from Yukino Bijin's home 
prefecture of Iwate, 
she was the very first Triple Crown 
winner—a living legend 
known to everyone in the racing world!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
T... Trainer-san! 
This is unbelievable...!
choice_data_list:
Let us accept her invitation with utmost 
respect!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The First Class car was so roomy, it plumb 
blew me away...! 
I'm so happy to visit home again, too... 
Um, thank you so much for having us today!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
"Look, it's Saint Lite-san..." 
"Goodness, how divine she looks." 
"Did she come out to see the town, I 
wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
Please, step into the car. 
Shall we?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeeees, gladlyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, guided by Saint Lite, 
we took a sightseeing tour around downtown 
Morioka.

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
I found myself longing for a leisurely 
stroll 
through this beloved land. 
How about you, my dear?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I love this town dearly too! 
Walking with you, Saint Lite-san, 
makes even familiar roads feel brand new.

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
"Grandpa, look! It's Saint Lite-sama~!" 
"Bless my soul... The races she ran for us 
are the pride of Morioka citizens 
everywhere..."

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
Good day to you all. 
What a serene and lovely day we are 
blessed with.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Golly, she's wicked popular...! 
So deeply adored by everyone... A true 
hero, she is.
choice_data_list:
That's because she's an extraordinary 
person!

That's because she's an extraordinary 
person!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After strolling through downtown, 
our next stop was a farm closely tied to 
Saint Lite.

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's heavenly... 
No matter how often I visit, it's so 
peaceful and gorgeous.

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
Please, make yourselves at home. 
Allow me to have some delicious soft serve 
brought over.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! 
Is this place... where you...?

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This is where it all began. 
You see, it was right over there that I 
ran as a child.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...! So this is where the legend was 
born! 
My heart's poundin' like crazy just 
standin' here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod firmly in agreement. 
Any true racing fan would be deeply moved 
by this.
choice_data_list:
After all, Saint Lite is practically 
synonymous with...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the dawn of racing, when everyone was 
groping in the dark, 
she left Iwate all by herself to take on 
the Central turf 
and claimed the first Triple Crown in 
history.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her career lasted a mere single year. 
A solitary horsegirl rewriting history 
with her very own legs!
choice_data_list:
The shining star of Iwate who created a 
legend...!

The shining star of Iwate who created a 
legend, indeed...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A distant legend... yet venturing from 
Iwate to the Central turf 
and chasing after her dreams with pure 
sincerity is just like Yukino Bijin. 
My chest swells with pride...!
choice_data_list:
You're going to carry on that legacy, 
Yukino!

You're going to carry on that legacy, 
Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whuh?! Th-That's way too big of an honor—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, but still... 
Maybe Trainer's right. 
I mean, even I...!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You're right...! 
We're out there runnin' with everything 
we've got, too!

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text: Oh, my.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Before you became a legend, 
you had to be just like me! 
A country girl dreaming of the Central 
turf...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So... there's nothin' sayin' I can't do 
it! 
I'm gonna become a star just like you!

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text: Well, now... how unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh...! 
I know I'm talkin' way outta turn, but... 
um...

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
I was looking forward to playing with you, 
wondering what kind of fluffy little 
creature you were, but...

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
Beneath that powdered snow lies rock-hard 
permafrost, doesn't it?
choice_data_list: That's exactly what she's made of...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, ma'am...! 
Yukino Bijin is a horsegirl with true 
Michinoku grit!

text_block_list.name: Saint Lite
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... 
The Classic season certainly looks 
promising.
